# Attio

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 43 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Dense CRM tables, configurable views, record panels and progressive onboarding with quiet neutral chrome and blue primary actions..

Captured 2026-10-31, Signed-in basic setup; Attio automatically provisioned a 14-day Pro trial. Public marketing captured separately.. Themes: light, dark.

The signed-in app was captured on 31 October 2026 from [Attio](https://attio.com). The owner completed sign-in and authorized onboarding. Attio automatically provisioned a 14-day Pro trial during basic setup. Those captures do not establish free-tier availability. No purchase, invitation, mailbox connection or record creation was submitted.

A public refresh on 21 November 2026 walked attio.com in headless Chromium at 1440 by 900 and 390 by 844, device pixel ratio 2. Sign in and Start for free both land on an empty welcome wall at app.attio.com. Nothing was typed. Google was not clicked. No form was submitted. The control map is [site-tree.md](site-tree.md). The wall is [login-review.json](login-review.json).

The package keeps the October app evidence and adds the public pages. The theme preference from October was restored to **System**, rendering dark. The temporary viewport override was reset.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- Do reserve the filled accent button for New Company; don't give every toolbar action equal emphasis. [Toolbar](components/crops/light-toolbar.png).
- Do separate navigation, view controls and data into stable horizontal bands; don't mix table controls into the sidebar. [Companies](screenshots/companies-light-scoped.png).
- Do place record attributes beside the overview and keep tabs above it; don't require leaving the record to inspect related material. [Record](screenshots/company-record-overview.png).
- Do keep sort priority visible as separate rows; don't hide sort direction. [Sorting](screenshots/companies-sort-light.png).

These are observations for this reference, not an official Attio design guide.
